Write the binomial expansion of $\left(2 - \frac{1}{2}x\right)^6$ up to the term in $x^3$:
$$\left(2 - \frac{1}{2}x\right)^6 = \binom{6}{0}2^6 + \binom{6}{1}2^5\left(-\frac{1}{2}x\right) + \binom{6}{2}2^4\left(-\frac{1}{2}x\right)^2 + \binom{6}{3}2^3\left(-\frac{1}{2}x\right)^3 + \dots$$

hints: Identify the terms from $(3 - x + 2x^3)$ that combine with $(64 - 96x + 60x^2 - 20x^3)$ to form $x^3$.
walkthrough:
Identify the pairs producing an $x^3$ term in the product $(3 - x + 2x^3)(64 - 96x + 60x^2 - 20x^3)$:
$$\text{Term in } x^3 = 3(-20x^3) + (-x)(60x^2) + (2x^3)(64)$$

Calculate the combined coefficient:
$$\text{Coefficient of } x^3 = 3(-20) - 1(60) + 2(64) = -60 - 60 + 128 = 8$$
